description: The person's grant to the stand-in: which decision kinds it may decide alone, and until when. A session the person asked sends GRANT_ASKED to the harness, which opens this actor (grant:<n>) with a checklist the machine generates (meta.checklist): one tick per decision class (spec decision meta.classes, each marked with its door), the one-way-door box, and end times counted from the ask. The actor asks the host to post the checklist card (postGrantCard); the host's ack names the card's message id (CARD_POSTED), and the person's ticks arrive as one tap event naming that card, PERSON_GRANTED {picks}, taken exactly like PERSON_DECIDED. The grant it reports to the harness (GRANT_GIVEN) is {card, kinds, oneWay, until, at} built from the picks alone; the harness holds one grant, so the tap replaces any earlier one. A grant decides a two-way door whose class it names, and a one-way door only when it names the class and has the one-way-door box; it decides nothing at or after until. Tapping a checklist with no kind ticked ends the live grant. The person can also grant in their own words: the same PERSON_GRANTED {picks}, from a message instead of a tap, goes to the harness itself (spec harness), with no checklist; a tap or a message replaces whatever grant came before.

checklist.description: The options, generated when the ask is opened: kind:<class> for every class in spec decision meta.classes, one-way (the one-way-door box), and until:<ISO time> for each of endsAfterHours after the ask's own time (receivedAt). A tap names any of the kinds, the box or not, and exactly one end time.

awaitingPerson.description: The checklist card is in front of the person. Its message id arrives with the ack of postGrantCard (CARD_POSTED), and only a tap on it grants.

CARD_POSTED.description: Refused unless a session sends it: the host session that posted the checklist acks the postGrantCard effect with the card's message id (harness ack <effect> --card <cmsg id>).
Refused unless it names one message id (cmsg_...) and this ask has no card yet.

PERSON_GRANTED.description: Refused unless the actor is a person and the source a tap: no session, agent or timer can grant.

Refused unless the tap's ref is this ask's card, the message id CARD_POSTED recorded on the ack of its postGrantCard effect. A tap on no card, an unposted card, a decision's or an audit's card, or an earlier checklist changes nothing.
Refused unless picks is a list of the card's own options, each at most once, with exactly one end time: a kind, a box or an end time the machine did not generate is refused.

granted.description: The person ticked the checklist. The harness holds the grant (GRANT_GIVEN) until its end time or the next tap on a checklist.
